translation: If one then divides the utmost numbers of Heaven and Earth and distinguishes the utmost indicators of yin and yang, when qi is in excess one harmonizes its Jingqu point to settle it, and when the will is insufficient one supplements its Fuliu point to nourish it, dissolving and flowing, regulating above and below. I have heard these words, but have not met such a person. I do not deceive the future; let me await the coming worthies.
